fusions.name: Wake Across the Pond
fusions.desc: You cut across the surface and send a wake 4 tiles ahead of you. It deals 11 water damage to everything in it, knocks each target back 2 tiles and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Taken From Below
fusions.desc: A weapon strike from underneath that deals 19 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 70% more damage for each one. It then leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Returned to Sender
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Unrippled Surface
fusions.desc: The moment your mana is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
